helper_scope: Ordinary exact dataclass Boolean fields; structured if/assignment/augmented-assignment/expression statements. Derive guards, object field reads/writes and ordered append sites from AST. Reject role aliasing/rebinding, DTO mutation, hidden control, unexpected queue mutations and reflection. Other object calls retain unknown effects.
queue_rule: Recognize a direct append following a write, or an immediate if object not in queue: queue.append(object) continuation. The latter only guarantees membership equality on the skipped branch; same-instance identity is unknown. Normal-completion source relation only, never a commit guarantee.
caller_scope: A unique positional helper invocation and later bulk wrapper invocation share the same initialized local list; reject intervening list rebind/escape/mutation. Literal projected fields must be forwarded by the wrapper to its unique .bulk_update call without rewriting the fields parameter. Other control/transaction effects are not proved.
assumptions: Declared function boundary, ordinary Boolean DTO fields, no hidden callbacks/backreferences mutating DTO roles, no external function monkeypatching. May-reach only; no branch feasibility, object alias closure, transaction or trigger summary.
unknown_rule: Missing Boolean context retains both values; dataclass defaults never narrow caller facts. Unsupported helper structure is unknown; unknown caller linkage preserves local facts but no confirmed write-plan path. Effects and full application labels remain unknown.
evaluation: Freeze source/static facts for three contexts before joining four existing Saleor labels. Known-source consistency only, no new label execution or independent accuracy claim. Include boundary tests for alias/equality, projection loss, list mutation, role changes and label isolation.
stop: One source-bound write-plan extraction; do not expand to full ORM/transaction analysis, new corpus, model fit or timing.
